title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description:
Gemini Group (csigemini.com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.com

The Role

The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.

In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.

As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini's M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini's deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.

Key Outcomes

  • Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals.
  • Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs.
  • Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini's M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities.
  • Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams.
  • Support the long-term build-out of Gemini's LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development.
  • Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal.
  • Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation.
  • Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit.
  • Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.

Relevant Experience & Competencies

  • At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector.
  • Experience in outbound deal origination planning.
  • Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities.
  • Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development.
  • Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.

Other Requirements

  • Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal.
  • Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required.
  • Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

Engenheiro(a) de Ventilação SêniorLocal:Fazenda Brasileiro – Teofilândia (BA), Brasil Quantidade de Vagas:01 Modelo de Trabalho:Presencial Disponibilidade:Mudança para a região (empresa oferece suporte)Sobre a Oportunidade Buscamos um(a)Engenheiro(a) de Ventilação Sêniorpara atuar namina subterrânea, sendo responsável pelo planejamento estratégico egestão do sistema de ventilação, bem como pelo acompanhamento de sua execução junto à equipe de Infraestrutura, assegurando condições adequadas de qualidade do ar, segurança operacional, conformidade legal e suporte eficiente às atividades de lavra e desenvolvimento da mina.Principais Responsabilidades Definir a estratégia de ventilação da mina subterrânea, garantindo alinhamento ao plano de negócios, à segurança dos trabalhadores e à sustentabilidade da operação;
Desenvolver e revisar projetos de ventilação para mina subterrânea (primária e secundária);
Realizar estudos de fluxo de ar, controle de gases, poeiras, temperatura e umidade;
Dimensionar ventiladores principais e auxiliares, dutos, portas e reguladores de ventilação;
Elaborar e manter atualizados os planos de ventilação da mina;
Propor e implementar inovações, melhorias tecnológicas e iniciativas de otimização de custos nos sistemas de ventilação, visando ganhos de produtividade, segurança e sustentabilidade;
Analisar riscos críticos relacionados à ventilação, gases, particulados e condições ambientais, apoiando a gestão de riscos operacionais e a tomada de decisão estratégica;
Atuar de forma integrada com geologia, planejamento de mina, produção, manutenção e SSMA;

Experiência sólida em ventilação de minas subterrâneas;
Vivência com softwares de ventilação (ex.: Ventsim, VentSim Design, VUMA ou similares);
Disponibilidade de mudança para Teofilândia, BA;
Pós-graduação ou especialização em Ventilação de Minas, Segurança do Trabalho (desejável).Se você tem interesse em ventilação de mina subterrânea, planejamento e controle da qualidade do ar, atuação em campo e liderança de equipes em um ambiente operacional dinâmico, essa vaga pode ser para você!

title: Data & Transportation Analyst - Advanced English
description:
About HCLTechHCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit Responsibilities: The Transportation Specialist will be responsible for supporting our e-Commerce Transportation Operation for North America. The specialist will work with carriers, customers and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.Core Responsibilities1. Data Analysis & Shipment Integrity (Primary Focus)
- Proactive Monitoring: Query large datasets to identify lagging or\ "at-risk\" shipments across sales, returns, and trade-in flows.
- Performance Reporting: Maintain and update centralized KPI boards and dashboards to ensure real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.
- SQL Management: Execute minor SQL queries to extract, filter, and audit transportation data from internal databases.
- Root Cause Analysis: Perform deep-dive investigations into weekly and monthly On-Time Delivery (OTD) fluctuations to identify systemic carrier or lane issues.2. Transportation Operations Support (Secondary Focus)
- Escalation Management: Resolve complex shipment status inquiries by collaborating with carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL), 3PL partners, and Fulfillment teams.
- Master Data Maintenance: Support the Transportation Operations Manager in configuring and troubleshooting master data within the Transportation Management System (TMS).
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the data subject matter expert (SME) for ongoing logistics projects and process improvement initiatives.Technical Requirements
- Data Handling: 1–3 years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a data-intensive operations role.
- SQL Proficiency: Ability to write and execute basic SQL queries for data extraction and manipulation.
- Advanced Tooling: Expert-level proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, complex formulas, data cleaning).
- Visualization: Experience maintaining or updating dashboards (e.G., Tableau, Looker, or Data Studio).Operational Requirements
- Industry Knowledge: Foundational understanding of parcel transportation or warehouse operations.
- Analytical Thinking: Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, identify trends in\ "noisy\" data, and propose actionable solutions.
- Communication: Strong ability to present data findings in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.
- Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.Preferred Skills/Qualifications:
- Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).
- Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.
- Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.
- Prior Forecasting experienceLocation: LATAM (Must align with US PST Time Zone)Language Requirement: Advanced EnglishWhy choose us? We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance.Equality & Opportunity for All Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: Data Analyst V
description: Título da posição:Data Analyst V BRL Tipo de contratação:Temporário via agência Modelo de trabalho:Home officeVisão Geral da Posição A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.O que você fará Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras. Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos. Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança. Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão. Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte. Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior. Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.Qualificações Mínimas Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada. Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance. Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente). Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI). Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais. Inglês fluente.Qualificações Desejáveis Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios. Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários). Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS). Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow). Experiência com big data ou frameworks de processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark). Experiência em organização global matricial.

title: Visual & Brand Experience Designer
description: Visual & Brand Experience DesignerAbout the Role We are seeking an experienced Visual & Brand Experience Designer to support a large-scale digital product initiative focused on modernizing the user experience of a leading marketplace platform. This role will play a key part in reimagining how customers navigate and interact with a multi-brand digital ecosystem.You will lead the Visual Makeover & Usability workstream while also helping shape a multi-brand gallery experience that brings together multiple brands within a single marketplace environment. The ideal candidate is a highly creative product designer who can quickly move from research and benchmarking into compelling visual concepts that inspire stakeholders and guide product direction.This is a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles, so comfort working in ambiguous environments and presenting bold ideas to senior stakeholders is essential.What You'll Do Design and lead the visual direction for key product workstreams focused on improving usability and modernizing the marketplace interface. Conduct benchmarking of leading global marketplace platforms to inform design strategy and identify best-in-class user experience patterns. Develop high-fidelity visual concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate new interface directions and inspire product leadership. Design and prototype a multi-brand navigation and discovery experience that enables users to seamlessly browse across brands within a unified marketplace. Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate design ideas into clear product directions. Present design concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders, helping guide decision-making around product experience and visual identity. Work within a fast-moving consulting team delivering iterative design outputs across short delivery cycles.Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in product design, visual design, or UI design Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality interface design and visual storytelling Deep understanding of e-commerce and marketplace design patterns Experience analyzing and benchmarking international digital products Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas Comfort presenting conceptual work to senior leadership and stakeholders Fluency in Portuguese (required working language) Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments with rapid iteration cyclesPreferred Qualifications Experience designing multi-brand digital ecosystems or marketplaces Familiarity with Asian marketplace and super-app UX paradigms such as those seen in Alibaba, Shopee, or Pinduoduo Background working with retail, consumer products, or marketplace platforms Previous experience in agency or consulting environments with fast delivery timelinesIf you're a designer who enjoys pushing visual boundaries, exploring global product patterns, and shaping the experience of large-scale digital platforms, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-visibility product initiative.

description:

title: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description: This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native iOS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.FlyMeOut is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.Js/TypeScript backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.Day to day, you'll be working on things like: Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with TypeScript Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the teamYou should have: 5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this) Strong experience with Expo, TypeScript, and modern state management (TanStack Query, Zustand, or similar) Backend capability with Node.Js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcomeNice to have: Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms Familiarity with booking/reservation systems Experience leading or mentoring other engineers Apple Pay integration experienceWhy FlyMeOut: Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026 Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up Work directly with the founder on product and technical directionCompensation & Terms This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise. Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month) Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible) Health benefits: Not offered at this stage Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis Probation: 2 weeks Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM BrasilHow to Apply Send your resume towith the subject lineFMO-RN-2026. In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

title: Cientista De Dados (Ia)
description:
Estamos em busca de umCientista de Dadoscom atuação na implementação de soluções comIA, sensoriamento remoto, geoprocessamento e análises espaciais.Formação: Graduado/Especializações em Matemática, Ciências Exatas, da Terra, Sensoriamento Remoto, Engenharia Cartográfica, Tecnologia da Informação e afins.Habilidades Técnicas: Linguagem de programação com foco em manipulação de dados (Python);
Conceitos de Estatística e Geoestatística;
Conhecimento em SQL/NoSQL;
Experiência em algoritmos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning;
Experiência em assistentes e agentes de IA integrados a modelos LLM;
Manipulação de dados espaço-temporais (geográficos com componente temporal);
Desejável conhecimento em sistemas de informação geográfica, sensoriamento remoto, geoprocessamento e análises eResponsabilidades e atribuições: Realizar tarefas regulares como: entendimento do problema de negócio, requisitos da solução, exploração de dados, treinamento e execução de modelos de Deep Learning e Machine Learning, análises estatísticas e geoestatísticas, configuração de fluxos de automação de processamento dos dados, confecção de relatórios e painéis de apresentação de informações;

Aplicar técnicas de reconhecimento de padrões, incluindo, mas não se limitando à visão computacional, modelos de redes neurais convolucionais (CNN), modelos de linguagem para processamento de linguagem natural (NLP), assistentes e agentes de IA integrados a Large Language Models (LLM) e análise de dados e análise preditiva (ML);

Participar e promover discussões técnicas e processos de ideação / inovação. Contribuindo para um ambiente de confiança, liberdade e troca, propício à criatividade;
Colaborar com a equipe de Data Science na construção de soluções.Por que escolher a Geosistemas?Saúde e Bem-Estar: Plano de Saúde e Odontológico - Sul América. Feedbacks regulares para apoiar sua evolução.Reconhecimento e Oportunidades: Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR) anual, vinculada ao desempenho. Movimentação Interna para explorar novas posições e crescer. Plano de Sucessão com foco no desenvolvimento de líderes e talentos juniores.Trabalhe conosco e faça parte de um time que investe no seu crescimento e bem-estar!

title: Senior Content Manager
description: As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media's growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.This role contributes directly to the CORE department's objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.To be more specific, you will:Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.The ideal profileWe're looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.You are someone who:Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must) Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus) Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing itYou bring strong CM fundamentals:High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills Ownership mindset over site and content performance Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals Experience working with CMS platformsYou work well with others and think ahead:Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potentialFeeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.Next steps in the process 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role's requirements 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!What's in it for youA full time remote work environment. A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results, not hours. Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path. Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun. We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!MoveUp MediaWe're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!Our approachWe focus on people. We put end users' experience as a priority on all strategies and processes. Thus, we aim to make complex topics easy to understand and provide exactly what our audience is seeking. We achieve this by carefully analyzing data and reflecting upon it, writing the content with care, and ensuring a smooth user experience.Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation. Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.Who We Are Looking For We are currently seeking aSenior Business Analyst – Supply Chain, a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution). This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts. If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.Key Responsibilities Business Requirements & Client Engagement
- Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.
- Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.
- Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.
- Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.
- Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.Solution Design, Implementation & Testing
- Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).
- Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.
- Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.
- Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.
- Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.
- Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.
- Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.
- Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)
- Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.
- Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.
- Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.Must Have
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.
- Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).
- Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.
- Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).
- Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.
- Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
- Experience with project management and collaboration tools.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.
- Availability to travel.
- Legally authorized to work in Brazil.What We Offer
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.
- A collaborative and international work environment.
- Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.Why Hoist? If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you. Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.ComThe Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini's M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini's deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini's M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini's LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.Relevant Experience & Competencies At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector. Experience in outbound deal origination planning. Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.Other Requirements Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal. Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required. Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga Afirmativa Para Pessoas Lgbtqiapn+
description:

Definir arquitetura de softwaree padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas deDevOps, CI/CD, testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes). Mentorar desenvolvedoresde diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração. title: Ux & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description: UX & Data-Driven Usability DesignerAbout the Role We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.What You'll Do Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment. Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process. Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns. Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains. Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience. Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact. Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences Strong problem-solving and research skills Fluency in Portuguese (required working language) Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelinesPreferred Qualifications Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testingThis role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Technical Lead
description:

He/she is a good team player who is part of a team responsible for delivering end-to-end application development and Operations Support.Responsibilities:

title: Coordenador De Banco De Dados
description:

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!Sobre a área: Lidar com diversos fornecedores de produtos e serviços que atendem a disciplina de Banco de Dados acompanhando, gerindo e cobrando ações quando necessário. Interagir com as áreas pares para entender e endereçar demandas, novos projetos, problemas, duvidas e reclamações a respeito do ambiente de Bando de Dados. Cuidar para que o ambiente se mantenha atualizado e com as ultimas features de segurança. Assegurar o uso otimizado dos recursos tecnológicos da plataforma através da análise das métricas de capacidade dos bancos de dados;
Planejar, elaborar e executar projetos de infraestrutura de Banco de Dados liderando equipes heterogêneas afim de otimizar e maximizar a performance de cada indivíduo além de atender as novas demandas das áreas de negócio;
Implantar recursos de bancos de dados para capacitar o ambiente a suportar crescimentos e demandas de negócio mesmo que ainda não mapeadas;
Apoiar, instruir e direcionar o time técnico afim de sanar dúvidas, questões técnicas ou processuais a respeito da disciplina de Banco de Dados;
Cumprir as metas estabelecidas no Contrato de Gestão e vigente, através da execução das ações previstas no plano de metas;
Principais atividades: Supervisionar e acompanhar a disciplina de Banco de Dados, participando de projetos e crises, contribuindo e orientando os seus liderados na forma de atuar e ser um facilitador nas interfaces com as outras disciplinas tanto de Operações, Engenharia de Infraestrutura e Engenharia de Desenvolvimento. Acompanhar, validar e medir a qualidade e saúde do ambiente de Banco de Dados. Estruturar e acompanhar os indicadores da area de Banco de Dados. Tracionar iniciativas de automação para a gestão do ambiente de Banco de Dados, reduzindo atividades operacionais e garantindo agilidade e tempo de resposta as mudanças de ambiente. Contribuir para obter um clima organizacional favorável, bem como a redução do turn over, através de ferramentas de gestão de pessoas, como contratações assertivas, comunicação interna eficaz, treinamento e desenvolvimento, reconhecimento e recompensa, buscando equipes de alta performance. Zelar pelo sigilo das informações tratadas na sua área de atuação. Cumprir as metas estabelecidas no Contrato de Gestão vigente, através da execução das ações previstas no plano de metas. Liderar um time de Banco de Dados com diversas stacks de Banco de Dados tanto onpremises quanto em Cloud.Buscamos alguém que apresente: Experiencia em gestão de pessoas Habilidade de construir matriz de decisão, RFPs e RFIs Experiencia de gestão financeira e de contratos de infraestrutura de TI Conhecimento Avançado de banco de dados SQL Server Conhecimento de Bancos Nativos Cloud Conhecimento de banco de dados My SQL (Desejável) Conhecimento de banco de dados No SQL (Desejável) Cursos e certificações correlatas a Banco de dadosAntes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que: - Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

- Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.Informações da vaga: Modelo de Trabalho (Home Office) Carga Horária: 220h Escala: Segunda a Sexta Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!Saúde e Bem-estar: - Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

title: Devops Engineer Sr
description:

The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‐minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‐scale production systems. You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‐efficient, and scalable solutions.Responsibilities and DutiesManage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
Lead AWS cost‐optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
Collaborate with cross‐functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
Ensure best‐in‐class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.Essential SkillsExpertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
Ability to identify andresolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;

title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation. Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts. - Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

- Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.Must Have
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

- Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
- Experience with project management and collaboration tools.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.
- Availability to travel.
- Legally authorized to work in Brazil.What We Offer
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.
- A collaborative and international work environment.
- Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.Why Hoist? If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you. Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Professor De Inglês
description: Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .Necessário:Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs. Required Qualifications & Skills: Education & Professional Knowledge:Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding ofIT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentalsto effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices. Project Management Skills:Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects usingproject management methodologies(Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.G., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes. Leadership & Communication:Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinatingcross-functional teams, managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner. Analytical & Problem-Solving:Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value. Preferred Qualifications: Advanced Knowledge:Familiarity withcybersecurity frameworks(e.G., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.G., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such ascloud computing projects, digital transformation, orAI-driven solutionsis a plus. Industry Experience:Prior experience in anIT services or consulting environment, managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background innetwork/security infrastructure projectsor software development projects is advantageous. Methodologies:Certifications or hands-on experience withAgile/Scrummethodologies (e.G., Certified Scrum Master) orDevOps/DevSecOpspractices. Experience Requirements: Experience:7+ yearsof experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential. Certifications: Project Management Certifications:Project Management Professional (PMP)orPRINCE2(highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise. Security/Technical Certifications:Certifications such asCertified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) ,Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), orCertified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por implementar e orquestrar microsserviços modernos, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (Kafka/RabbitMQ) assumindo entregas de ponta a ponta, da implementação ao deploy em produção. Elaborar templates de arquitetura de aplicação de referência para o time, sempre que demandado;

Implementar e disseminar práticas de observabilidade (OpenTelemetry, APM com Datadog/NewRelic/Dynatrace) e tracing distribuído para aumentar a previsibilidade operacional;
Conduzir code reviews de alto padrão, orientando o time em boas práticas de arquitetura, design patterns, testes e segurança;
Atuar em integrações complexas com sistemas internos e externos, aplicando padrões de resiliência como Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA;
Identificar gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria em queries SQL, estratégias de cache e configurações de pool de conexões para otimizar a performance das aplicações;
Apoiar diretamente líderes técnicos (Tech Leads) em acordos técnicos entre squad, produto e demais áreas, traduzindo complexidade técnica em impacto de negócio de forma clara e rastreável;

Aprimorar continuamente os processos e práticas de desenvolvimento, aplicando técnicas de uso de Inteligência Artificial para otimizar o desenvolvimento de software, de forma avançada e responsável.Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:Profundidade em Java avançado: Multithread, gerenciamento de memória/GC, Virtual Threads (Java 21) e domínio das diferenças entre versões LTS, bem como domínio total de programação funcional;
Domínio amplo de DesignPatterns com capacidade de reconhecer o momento certo de aplicá-los;
entendimento de como a Injeção de Dependência funciona internamente (Reflection/Proxies);
Experiência sólida com Spring (Boot, Data, Security) e uso de frameworks reativos;
Domínio de estratégias de resiliência em integrações: Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA (ex: Resilience4j);
domínio do conceito de Idempotência;

Experiência prática comcomponentes de pelo menos uma Cloud (AWS ou GCP) Capacidade real e experiência em Documentação como código usando Mermaid ou PlantUML através de arquivos markdown;
Domínio sólido de estratégias em pelo menos uma ferramenta de IA assistida (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity ou Claude Code), bem como experiência prática de consumo de pelo menos 1 tipo de MCP Server através destas ferramentas.Você irá se destacar se:Ser committer ativo em repositórios open-source relevantes;

postgraduate qualification preferred. Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills;
fluency inPortuguese and English. Must meetfit and properstandards withno disqualifying factors, including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised. not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Sr. Backend Engineer
description: About You You are a senior-level Backend Engineer (Node.Js) who thrives in challenging environments and enjoys taking ownership of complex systems to transform them into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions.You are highly hands-on and comfortable working with evolving or partially structured codebases. You can quickly assess risks, identify critical issues, and execute remediation strategies under tight timelines. You value clean code, security best practices, and reliable system behavior.You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical challenges clearly, and play a key role in stabilizing applications and restoring confidence in production systems. You are motivated by making a tangible impact and contributing to the successful relaunch and future scalability of a critical platform.You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies: 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend development using Node.Js. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience. Strong experience working with REST APIs and third-party integrations. Proven experience handling legacy systems, codebase audits, or technical recovery scenarios. Solid understanding of application security best practices, including secure handling of sensitive data. Hands-on experience with AWS environments and services. Experience setting up or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines. Strong experience working with PostgreSQL databases (RDS preferred). Familiarity with proxies, CORS, and common web security vulnerabilities (e.G., SSRF). Ability to work in fast-paced environments with ambiguous or incomplete documentation. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize issues based on business impact. Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus). Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Take ownership of the Node.Js backend and perform a full technical assessment of the codebase. Identify and remediate critical security vulnerabilities and insecure integrations. Refactor unstable or low-quality code to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance. Stabilize core application flows required for production readiness. Re-establish codebase ownership by organizing and migrating repositories within the client environment. Analyze and restore CI/CD pipelines across repositories and environments. Set up and validate staging environments to support testing and release processes. Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms. Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes. Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability. Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes. Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development. Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability.Qualifications 5+ years of experience in Node.Js backend development. Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects. Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL. Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations. Advanced English proficiency.Additional Information About UsWe Are Engineered Different.At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values:Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Electrical Bim Lead
description: Eracoreis an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U.S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects, including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look: is growing inBrazil, and we are excited to welcome new team members. If you enjoy teamwork, learning, and doing quality work, you will feel at home with us.Why You'll Enjoy Working at Eracore Competitive hourly pay Fully remote work Learning platforms for professional growth Supportive leadership and mentorshipYour Role Lead and support the development of Electrical BIM models Review models, perform clash detection, and ensure quality standards Support and mentor BIM team members Coordinate with other BIM trades Prepare BIM documents such as reports, schedules, execution plans and shop drawings Work daily with Revit and Navisworks and Bluebeam Improve workflows and modeling processes when needed Communicate clearly with client BIM teams throughout the projectWhat We're Looking For 4+ years of experience in Electrical BIM Strong understanding of electrical systems Advanced Revit skills with an electrical focus Experience using Navisworks for coordination and clash detection Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, and Bluebeam Team-oriented mindset with experience in managing the team 2+ successfully finished projects Reliable, organized, and deadline-focused

title: Data Scientist - Remote - Talent Pool
description: We're building a talent pool forSenior Data Scientist Engineers. This pipeline role is for engineers with strongSQL and Python experience. This position plays a key role in supporting product decision-making through data analysis, reporting, and business intelligence.What You'll Do Help clear existing backlog and enhance the team's data infrastructure and analytics capabilities. Work with ETL processes, analytics, and BI tools to drive actionable insights. Create and maintain data pipelines and workflows using Airflow. Perform data cleaning, transformation, and combination of existing data tables in Snowflake. Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to deliver accurate reporting and analytics. Contribute to Streamlit dashboards and analytical tools.What We're Looking For Proven experience with Python and SQL in a data-focused environment. Familiarity with data tools such as Airflow, Snowflake, and Streamlit. Strong understanding of analytics best practices and product data workflows. Basic knowledge or interest in cryptocurrencies, blockchain technology, and ERC-20 tokens. Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal. Ability to work effectively across time zones with overlap to US hours (preferably Eastern Time).Nice to Have Prior experience in fintech, payments, or digital assets. Understanding of blockchain data structures or related crypto analytics.Why Join Kake? Kake is a remote-first company with a global community — fully believing that it's not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world's most innovative companies, and we've built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We're proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career — we're the destination.The icing on the Kake: Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally. Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you. Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions. Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang)
description: This position offers you the opportunity to join a fast-growing technology organization that is redefining productivity paradigms in the software engineering industry. Thanks to our flexible, distributed model of global operation and the high caliber of our experts, we have enjoyed triple digit growth over the past five years, creating amazing career opportunities for our people.If you want to accelerate your career working with like-minded subject matter experts, solving interesting problems and building the products of tomorrow, this opportunity is for you.We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with strong Go (Golang) expertise and hands-on experience building secure, high-throughput systems in crypto, blockchain, or financial domains. This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, cryptography, and regulated financial infrastructure, contributing to mission-critical platforms that process high-value transactions at scale.The impact you'll make:Design, implement, and maintain high-availability backend services using Go (Golang). Build and evolve crypto-native systems, including wallets, custody services, transaction pipelines, and blockchain integrations. Develop secure APIs and internal services that handle sensitive financial and cryptographic operations. Collaborate with product and architecture teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions. Optimize systems for performance, reliability, and fault tolerance in distributed environments. Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and production incident resolution. Ensure compliance with security, auditability, and regulatory requirements typical of financial and crypto platforms. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native deployment strategies. Act as a technical advisor within the engagement, supporting best practices and engineering excellenceTechnology Stack:Go (Golang) BlockchainWhat you'll bring to us:5+ years of backend engineering experience, with a strong focus on Go. Prior exposure to crypto, fintech, payments, or financial infrastructure is highly preferred. Experience working in consulting, staff augmentation, or cross-team delivery models is a plus. Ability to operate autonomously while collaborating effectively with distributed teams. Strong communication skills in English, able to explain complex technical topics to mixed audiences. Pragmatic problem-solver with a delivery-oriented mindset. Comfortable working in fast-moving environments with evolving requirements. Ability to balance client needs, technical quality, and delivery timelines. Desirable experience with Hashing (SHA-256, Keccak), Digital signatures (ECDSA, EdDSA), Go crypto libraries, Blockchain. Required to be located in Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro.Some of the benefits you'll enjoy working with us:The chance to work in innovative projects with leading brands, that use the latest technologies that fuel transformation. The opportunity to be part of an amazing, multicultural community of tech experts. A flexible and remote working environment.

title: Ugc Content Creator (Freelance)
description: About the Company We are a fast-growing global mobile app company building digital products used by millions of people worldwide. Our focus is on creating scalable, data-driven consumer applications that combine creativity, technology, and performance marketing.Role Overview Produce high-quality 30–60 second short-form videos for TikTok and Instagram, promoting consumer-focused mobile applications to global audiences. Translate creative briefs into compelling, performance-oriented content while also bringing fresh, original ideas to the table. Develop powerful hooks, relatable scenarios, and innovative use cases that capture attention within the first seconds. Continuously research trends, viral formats, and competitor strategies to keep content relevant and competitive. Collaborate closely with the Marketing team to align content with growth goals, campaign strategy, and performance metrics. Share learnings and creative suggestions that help improve overall content strategy, engagement rates, and conversion performance.Candidate Profile Strong interest in TikTok, Instagram Reels, and short-form content ecosystems. Ability to create engaging, high-retention videos that align with platform trends (portfolio or sample work is highly preferred). Strong creative instinct with the ability to turn everyday concepts into attention-grabbing content. Confidence on camera — or strong storytelling ability without appearing on camera. Understanding of audience behavior, content psychology, and the importance of the first 3 seconds. Self-driven and organized, capable of managing freelance deliverables independently. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, feedback-driven environment. English proficiency is a plus, as content targets an international audience.Compensation Per-Video Payment Model:You'll receive compensation for each completed and approved video, with ongoing project opportunities based on performance

title: Coordenador De Banco De Dados
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo: Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas. Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!Sobre a área: Lidar com diversos fornecedores de produtos e serviços que atendem a disciplina de Banco de Dados acompanhando, gerindo e cobrando ações quando necessário. Interagir com as áreas pares para entender e endereçar demandas, novos projetos, problemas, duvidas e reclamações a respeito do ambiente de Bando de Dados. Cuidar para que o ambiente se mantenha atualizado e com as ultimas features de segurança. Assegurar o uso otimizado dos recursos tecnológicos da plataforma através da análise das métricas de capacidade dos bancos de dados;
Planejar, elaborar e executar projetos de infraestrutura de Banco de Dados liderando equipes heterogêneas afim de otimizar e maximizar a performance de cada indivíduo além de atender as novas demandas das áreas de negócio;
Implantar recursos de bancos de dados para capacitar o ambiente a suportar crescimentos e demandas de negócio mesmo que ainda não mapeadas;
Apoiar, instruir e direcionar o time técnico afim de sanar dúvidas, questões técnicas ou processuais a respeito da disciplina de Banco de Dados;
Cumprir as metas estabelecidas no Contrato de Gestão e vigente, através da execução das ações previstas no plano de metas;
Principais atividades: Supervisionar e acompanhar a disciplina de Banco de Dados, participando de projetos e crises, contribuindo e orientando os seus liderados na forma de atuar e ser um facilitador nas interfaces com as outras disciplinas tanto de Operações, Engenharia de Infraestrutura e Engenharia de Desenvolvimento. Acompanhar, validar e medir a qualidade e saúde do ambiente de Banco de Dados. Estruturar e acompanhar os indicadores da area de Banco de Dados. Tracionar iniciativas de automação para a gestão do ambiente de Banco de Dados, reduzindo atividades operacionais e garantindo agilidade e tempo de resposta as mudanças de ambiente. Contribuir para obter um clima organizacional favorável, bem como a redução do turn over, através de ferramentas de gestão de pessoas, como contratações assertivas, comunicação interna eficaz, treinamento e desenvolvimento, reconhecimento e recompensa, buscando equipes de alta performance. Zelar pelo sigilo das informações tratadas na sua área de atuação. Cumprir as metas estabelecidas no Contrato de Gestão vigente, através da execução das ações previstas no plano de metas. Liderar um time de Banco de Dados com diversas stacks de Banco de Dados tanto onpremises quanto em Cloud.Buscamos alguém que apresente: Experiencia em gestão de pessoas Habilidade de construir matriz de decisão, RFPs e RFIs Experiencia de gestão financeira e de contratos de infraestrutura de TI Conhecimento Avançado de banco de dados SQL Server Conhecimento de Bancos Nativos Cloud Conhecimento de banco de dados My SQL (Desejável) Conhecimento de banco de dados No SQL (Desejável) Cursos e certificações correlatas a Banco de dadosAntes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que: - Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;
- Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;
- Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;
- Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;
- Planejem e executem otrabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;
- Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.Informações da vaga: Modelo de Trabalho (Home Office) Carga Horária: 220h Escala: Segunda a Sexta Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!Saúde e Bem-estar: - Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;
- Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;
- Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;
- Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;
- Licença maternidade epaternidade estendidas;
- Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.Proteção e estabilidade: - Previdência privada;
- Participação nos lucros;
- Seguro de vida.Facilidades para o dia a dia: - Vale-Alimentação;
- Vale-Refeição;
- Vale-Transporte;

Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente
